实例备注信息。

长度为2~256个字符，不能以http:// 或者https:// 开头。
description.en:
The description of the instance.

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http:// or https://.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的实例ID。
description.en:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the instance IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region.

description.zh: 该参数已废弃，无需传入该参数。
description.en: This parameter is no longer used.

descriptions.en:
To make it easy to identify AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances, you can call this operation to modify the description of instances.

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-db-instance-description --resource-group-id example-string --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --db-instance-description test --region cn-hangzhou
